release_notes.en-US:
Paste links: add links to a saved session without opening it.

- Copy links from anywhere (a list, your notes, an email), click a tab-group header, window or tab in a saved session and press Ctrl+V. In the session list, Ctrl+V makes a new session.
- A check comes first: an editable box showing how many links will be added, which are already there and which lines had no link. Ctrl+Enter adds; Ctrl+Z takes it back.
- Reads one link per line, Markdown, "link title" lines, links inside ordinary text, and example.com/page without https://. Markdown from Copy as Markdown comes back with its windows and tab groups.
- Into a group, the links join it. After a tab, they go right after it. Into a window, pasted groups are kept.
- "Add links…" is in the group, tab and window menus, and "New session from links…" in the Save menu.
- No new permissions: only your own paste brings text in, and nothing is fetched to look up titles.
- Settings → Import URL list reads links the same way and no longer loads icons from Google's favicon service.
